children: Rein Therapeutics published a presentation on LTI-03 highlighting Phase 1b biomarker activity, preclinical antifibrotic data and that the RENEW Phase 2 trial is now enrolling.
Published investor presentation on LTI-03 and furnished it as Exhibit 99.1 under Regulation FD.
Phase 1b (NCT05954988) showed inhaled 5mg and 10mg were well tolerated with no treatment-related SAEs.
Exploratory Phase 1b biomarkers in deep bronchial brushings reached nominal significance, consistent with target engagement.
Preclinical and ex vivo data show LTI-03 attenuates profibrotic signaling and promotes alveolar epithelial restoration.
RENEW Phase 2 trial (NCT06968845) for idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis is now enrolling.
